summary: Burst of 1.00 auths on donation and gift-card merchants from a headless browser, card blocked after chargebacks on the follow-up 400.00 purchase.
Card enumerated across small US merchants overnight; BIN range attack confirmed by scheme alert.
Account takeover: credentials phished, new device from abroad buying electronics far above usual spend.
SIM swap followed by a high-value ecom order; 3DS passed via the swapped number, still fraud.
Cardholder bought a new laptop on a new phone. Same country, 3DS passed. Customer confirmed.
Holiday spend in a neighbouring country, POS, chip and PIN. Classic traveller.
Traveller booking a hotel from a hotel laptop abroad; 3DS authenticated in the banking app.
Large deposit at an offshore casino. Not fraud, but flagged for responsible-gambling follow-up.
Stolen card used to buy crypto through an exchange's card on-ramp from a fresh device.
Several small transit taps within an hour during a commute. Normal.
